collection.title: Sample collection
collection.description: Patients waiting to have samples drawn. STAT and urgent orders come first.
collection.scanLabel: Scan a tube label to mark it as collected
collection.empty: Nobody is waiting for a sample draw
collection.emptyHint: New orders appear here as soon as reception registers them.

reception.title: Sample reception
reception.description: Scan each tube as it reaches the bench. The list below shows every scan and its outcome.
reception.emptyIncoming: No tubes on their way to the bench
reception.emptyRejected: No rejected tubes in this period

reject.title: Reject tube
reject.description: The tube can't be used. Its tests stop until a new sample is drawn.
reject.recollectHint: A new tube (next number) takes over this tube's tests, and the collection staff are notified.
reject.doneRecollect: Rejected. New tube {{barcode}} is waiting to be drawn

storage.storeHint: Where is the tube kept? Rack, fridge or freezer position.
storage.transferHint: The tube is in transit until someone receives it at the destination.
storage.destinationExample: e.g. Main lab, Kafr Sousa branch, reference lab
storage.disposeHint: Tube {{barcode}} will be marked as disposed. This is recorded in the audit log.

worklist.title: Worklists
worklist.description: Enter, check and verify results tube by tube. Analyzer values arrive here by themselves.
worklist.emptyHint: Tubes appear once they are received at the bench.

entry.commentHint: Printed under the result on the report.
entry.rerunHint: {{name}} = {{value}} will be cleared and wait for a new measurement. Earlier attempts are kept.
entry.criticalSaved_one: {{count}} critical result — call the doctor and record the call
entry.criticalSaved_other: {{count}} critical results — call the doctor and record each call
entry.verifySkipped_one: {{count}} result skipped (no value or already verified)
entry.verifySkipped_other: {{count}} results skipped (no value or already verified)

critical.label: Critical
critical.callHint: Who received the critical value by phone? The report can't be released until the call is recorded.
critical.readBack: The value was read back to me
critical.banner_one: {{count}} critical result without a recorded call
critical.banner_other: {{count}} critical results without a recorded call
critical.bannerHint: Phone the doctor (or the patient), then record who took the call. Release stays blocked until then.
critical.releaseBlocked: Record the call for every critical result first

validation.title: Medical validation
validation.description: Review results with their ranges and history, sign, then release the report.
validation.emptyHint: Orders appear here once results are entered or verified.
validation.pick: Choose an order from the queue

amend.title: Amend released result
amend.description: The old value is kept, the result is marked as amended, and a new report version replaces the current one.
amend.missing: Enter the corrected value and a reason.

reports.noneHint: Validate the results, then release the report.
reports.readyToRelease_one: {{count}} validated result is ready to release.
reports.readyToRelease_other: {{count}} validated results are ready to release.

delivery.title: Report delivery
delivery.description: Released reports and how each one reached the patient.
delivery.empty: No released reports in this period
delivery.emptyHint: Reports appear here once they are released after validation.
delivery.linkCopied: Patient link copied. The patient opens it with the code on the receipt.
delivery.whatsappOpened: WhatsApp opened with the message ready to send
delivery.whatsappNote: WhatsApp opens on this computer with the message ready: WhatsApp's business service can't reach Syrian numbers, so the desk sends it from its own account.

portal.title: Your test results
portal.heading: Open your report
portal.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit access code printed on your receipt.
portal.lookupHint: Enter the order number and the 6-digit access code from your receipt.
portal.privacy: Your report is private. After five wrong codes this link stops working.
portal.askLab: Ask the lab to send you a new link.
portal.keepPrivate: Keep this page private. Anyone with the link and your code can see these results.

verify.title: Report verification
verify.subtitle: Check that a printed report is genuine
verify.enterHint: It is printed next to the QR code at the bottom of the report.
verify.notFoundHint: Code {{code}} doesn't match any report. Check the code, or contact the lab.
verify.genuineHint: This is the current version of the report issued by the lab.
verify.supersededHint: Version {{version}} is genuine but was replaced: the lab issued version {{latest}}. Ask for the latest report.
verify.noResults: Results are never shown on this page. Only the patient can open them, with the link and code from the lab.
